12: // V7.1.2: iOS 15+ safe replacement for deprecated UIApplication.windows.
13: static NSArray<UIWindow *> *RSAllApplicationWindows(void) {
14:     NSMutableArray<UIWindow *> *result = [NSMutableArray array];
15:     NSSet<UIScene *> *scenes = [UIApplication sharedApplication].connectedScenes;
16:     for (UIScene *scene in scenes) {
17:         if (![scene isKindOfClass:[UIWindowScene class]]) continue;
18:         UIWindowScene *windowScene = (UIWindowScene *)scene;
19:         [result addObjectsFromArray:windowScene.windows];
20:     }
21:     return result;
22: }
